before settlers took it over?

Norteamérica antes de que los

title: English Settlement Reasons
questionReadAloudEn:
What are two reasons people
from England moved to North
America?
answerReadAloudEn:
1. To make money
2. To have their own religion

title: Colony
answerReadAloudEn:
Territory that is controlled by
another country.

title: Original Colony Regions
questionReadAloudEn:
Label the three regions of the
original colonies.
answerReadAloudEn: The three regions are New England, Middle, and Southern.
questionReadAloudEs:
Etiqueta las tres regiones de las
colonias originales.

title: Regional Economies
questionReadAloudEn:
How did the Northern and
Southern regions make money?
answerReadAloudEn:
The North made money with
industry.
The South made money with
agriculture.
questionReadAloudEs:
¿Cómo generaban ingresos las
regiones del norte y del sur?
answerReadAloudEs:
El Norte ganó dinero
conindustria.
El Sur ganó dinero
conagricultura.

title: Slavery

person.

posee y controla a otra.

title: Thirteen Colonies Control
Declaration of Independence
questionReadAloudEn:
What was the Declaration of
Independence?
answerReadAloudEn:
The official document that
announced the 13 colonies
separated from Britain

title: American Revolution Cause
questionReadAloudEn:
What was the American
Revolution fought over?
answerReadAloudEn:
The colonists wanted
independence from Britain
and to have their own
government.
